content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Douglas Salinas (E045)
- Role: Engineer
- Employment type: contractor
- Security training: basic (not advanced)

Requested: write access to Payroll.

Policy:
- Contractor: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.
- Douglas has basic security training, so maximum is read.

Requested write > maximum read. Grant maximum = read.

Note: Payroll is owned by Payroll Specialist role, but Douglas is Engineer, and contractor anyway, so admin not possible.

Decision: read.
